title: Add signed-in password change

pr.title: Add signed-in password change
pr.body:
## Summary
- Signed-in players can change their password from the profile menu. The current session stays logged in and every other session is revoked.
- Wrong, weak, unchanged, and database failures are counted on the API (`arcade_password_change_*`) and the form (`arcade_web_password_change_*`).
- An existing admin password is no longer reset to `admin` on API restart.

## Test plan
- [ ] Open the profile menu and choose change password.
- [ ] Submit a wrong current password, a password shorter than 4 characters, and the same password again. Each shows an error.
- [ ] Submit a matching new password. The form confirms the update, this browser stays signed in, and a second session for the same account is signed out.
- [ ] Log in with the new password, and confirm the old password is rejected.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

commitMessage:
Add a signed-in password change that signs out other sessions.

Players can update their password from the profile menu, with API and web error metrics for wrong, weak, and unchanged passwords.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
